notes: R61 defines the pricing configuration rule as a foundational requirement for authorized users to define and manage rental pricing structures. The core operative rules are well-established in TOOLCHAIN-CONF-PAYMENT-01.md (E5, E8). However, significant gaps exist around precision handling (fractions, rounding), multi-currency behavior, and the relationship between display and persisted values. E3 and E4 highlight unresolved concerns from Finance and QA about whether currency presentation and display simplifications can diverge from underlying financial records. E9 signals an active multi-currency conversion rule conflict that must be resolved. The requirement depends on R62 (Rental cost calculation rule) for downstream pricing logic.
